dish.title: Herbed Polenta with Tomato Stew
dish.name: Herbed Polenta with Tomato Stew
dish.description: Soft stovetop polenta with a burst cherry-tomato and white-bean stew finished with fresh rosemary.

recipe_version.title: Herbed Polenta with Tomato Stew
recipe_version.description: Soft stovetop polenta with a burst cherry-tomato and white-bean stew finished with fresh rosemary.
recipe_version.doneness: Polenta thick and soft, pulling from the side of the pan. Tomatoes burst; stew spoonable, not watery.

substitutions.butter or cheese: Do not add butter or cheese. Either one would drop the dairy-free claim.
substitutions.rosemary: Use fresh. Do not use 1 tbsp dried rosemary.

ingredients.name: polenta
ingredients.note: coarse or medium-grind corn polenta, not instant

ingredients.name: fresh rosemary
ingredients.note: chopped leaves, not dried. The herb stays in the stew, which is where v1 put it.

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.note: low-sodium, with no milk, wheat, or soy in the ingredient list

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: to burst the tomatoes. Not butter.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: 3/4 tsp in the broth, 1/4 tsp in the stew. Diamond Crystal. If Morton, use half. Assumes low-sodium broth; if the broth is already salty, use half of each portion.

steps.title: Cook the polenta
steps.body: Bring the vegetable broth and 3/4 tsp of the kosher salt to a simmer in a heavy saucepan. Whisk in the polenta. Cook over low heat, stirring often, 20 minutes, until the polenta is thick and soft and pulls from the side of the pan. This is stovetop. There is no sheet pan.

steps.title: Stew the tomatoes
steps.body: While the polenta cooks, warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the cherry tomatoes, fresh rosemary, the remaining 1/4 tsp kosher salt, and the black pepper. Cook until the tomatoes burst, about 8 minutes. Stir in the drained white beans and cook 2 minutes more, until the stew is spoonable rather than watery.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the stew over the soft polenta. Four servings. Do not add cheese or butter.

projection.vocabulary_note: Dropped v1 tag citrusy. There is no citrus in the recipe. Did not add lemon to justify the tag.
projection.allergen_note: No major allergen if the broth contains no milk, wheat, or soy. Dietary eligibility is separate: plant and dairy-free.
